$comment: Source registry. Every provenance sourceId must appear here. Only list retrievals that actually happened. Human-readable detail: docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (via Overpass API)
sources.accessNotes: Queried through the public Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter); no account. Usage policy: under 10,000 queries and 1 GB per day; run tools/fetch-osm.ts rarely and commit snapshots.

licence.name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0

sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under the Open Database License (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright).
obligations: Display the attribution wherever the data or anything produced from it is shown.
Derived databases that are publicly used or distributed must be offered under ODbL (share-alike).
Crowd-sourced: completeness and accuracy are not guaranteed; signal and switch tagging is partial.

retrievals.description: Railway extract for the shrewsbury bbox (52.695-52.745 N, 2.770-2.725 W), including named junctions, yards and level crossings (data/raw/osm/shrewsbury-2026-10-27.json), overpass-api.de. Supersedes an earlier same-day extract (base 2026-10-27T16:01:40Z) with a smaller bbox.
Carlisle PILOT extract, bbox 54.870-54.940 N, 2.985-2.895 W, standard query (data/raw/osm/carlisle-2026-10-27.json), overpass-api.de. See docs/pilots/CARLISLE_PILOT.md.

Carlisle Phase 2 MAIN refresh (data/raw/osm/carlisle-20261027T184451Z.json, sha256 e6c49d21b6fe95b1dc4f7bd2b44bf709feff5e87efd4d5ccd2ee2d3a32cddc9e). Purpose: like-for-like refresh. Query byte-identical to the pilot extract (bbox 54.870-54.940 N, 2.985-2.895 W; railway=rail ways with all nodes; platform/station/halt/signal_box; signal/switch/buffer_stop/railway_crossing nodes; named junction/yard/level_crossing; named landuse=railway; out body center), https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter, retrieved 2026-10-27T18:48:40Z after two HTTP 502 'server at capacity' responses (18:44Z, 18:45Z). 2,014 elements, identical in content to the pilot extract. Used for the carlisle infrastructure.json from Phase 2 (D-019).

Carlisle Phase 2 SUPPLEMENT (data/raw/osm/carlisle-20261027T184451Z-supplement.json, 4.5 MB, sha256 c75cb89ac709a8e074aa3b828d41794b88dbde3f0148585f11161d5ef6e91f3c; kept local and git-ignored by owner decision, see D-019; the recorded hash identifies the input but does not guarantee its availability or redistribution rights). Purpose: additions to the main query's scope, same bbox: railway=platform|platform_edge and public_transport=platform with full geometry (out geom); railway=construction|disused|abandoned|proposed|narrow_gauge|light_rail|miniature|preserved ways (out geom); nodes with railway:signal:* tags but no railway=signal; railway=derail|stop|milestone|crossing_box|owner_change|switch_heater|train_protection|vacancy_detection nodes; relations containing the bbox's railway=rail ways and stop_area relations. https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter, retrieved 2026-10-27T18:47:40Z after one HTTP 502. 130 elements. Committed derivative: data/raw/osm/carlisle-20261027T184451Z-supplement-slim.json (tools/slim-osm-supplement.ts; 82 elements; 48 route=train/historic relations omitted and listed; 4 route=railway relations kept with members filtered to in-extract ways).

sources.name: Network Rail Open Data Feeds (SCHEDULE, CORPUS, SMART, BPLAN, TD, TRUST, VSTP)
sources.accessNotes: Free account required; first come first served, capped at 1,000 users. Static files (SCHEDULE CIF/JSON, CORPUS, SMART) are downloaded with authenticated HTTP GET. The user must register and download files; this project does not hold credentials. SMART: supplied by the owner on 2026-10-27 (data/private/SMARTExtract.json).

licence.name: Network Rail Infrastructure Limited Data Feeds Licence: use under the Open Government Licence (version not stated on the licence page; OGL v3.0 is current)

sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
obligations: Do not use the Network Rail brand or logo, or those of National Rail or train companies.
Do not describe the application as 'official'.
Attribution uses the OGL v3.0 default statement because the licence page gives no specific wording (decision D-009); replace it if Network Rail specifies one.
Raw extracts stay in git-ignored data/private/; only derived study-area snapshots are committed.

sources.name: OpenRailwayMap
sources.accessNotes: Rendered map of OSM railway data. Used by humans to cross-check OSM tagging; nothing is imported from it.

sources.name: UK bank holidays (GOV.UK bank-holidays.json)
sources.accessNotes: Public JSON, no account. Fetched once with curl and committed as a dated snapshot (data/raw/govuk/).
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
obligations: Attribute the source (OGL v3.0); GOV.UK's terms give no specific wording, so the OGL default statement is used.
GOV.UK's terms page footer states OGL v3.0, while its body text links to OGL v1; v3.0 is used.

retrievals.description: England and Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland bank holidays (data/raw/govuk/bank-holidays-2026-10-27.json). Used only to decide whether a snapshot window holds a bank holiday (D-026).

sources.notes: Says which dates are bank holidays. It does not say how a CIF bank-holiday running flag applies to a train.
